scenes.heading: AI UI DESIGN LOOKS SAME
scenes.say: Why does AI UI design all look the same?

scenes.heading: ADD IT TO YOUR AGENT
scenes.say: It's called unslop, a skill for Claude Code or Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking screens into a designed interface.

scenes.heading: IT FINDS THE SLOP
scenes.say: First it audits the screen and lists the slop: gradients, glows, emoji labels. Then it sets a direction from your product.

scenes.heading: REDLINE, PASS BY PASS
scenes.say: You steer that direction first. Then it fixes the screen pass by pass: spacing, color, icons, copy, type, motion, like a designer's redline review.

scenes.heading: WORKS IN YOUR STACK
scenes.say: It works in Next.js, React, Vue or plain CSS, and on a live site when a link is all you have.

scenes.heading: THE CATCH
scenes.say: The catch: you need Claude Code or Codex, and the story video needs Playwright and ffmpeg.
Would you let it redraw your own app? Comment UNSLOP and I'll pin the repo.

claims.text: unslop is a skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface.
It audits the screen and names the slop it finds, then sets a direction from the product before it edits anything.
It fixes the screen pass by pass: spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion.
It works in the viewer's own stack and on a live site when only a link is available.
